podcast.body: The opening track from The Black Keys' eighth studio album, *Turn Blue*. The title gains deeper meaning when understood in the context of Dan Auerbach's divorce, which influenced the album's lyrics. The song's sound has been compared to Pink Floyd's work from the 1970s. "Weight of Love from the Black Keys 8th studio album Turn Blue..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
